duas.title: The Opening Supplication
duas.translation: Guide us to the straight path.

duas.title: Dua of Ibrahim (AS)
duas.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْ هَٰذَا الْبَلَدَ آمِنًا وَاجْنُبْنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعْبُدَ الْأَصْنَامَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbij'al hadhal-balada aminan wajnubni wa baniyya an na'budal-asnam
duas.translation: My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
